tasks.title: Testify configuration settings panel
acceptance: Per-map settings (omitCreateFields, preferredCreateValues, cePollTimeoutMinutes, allowPartialEnumCoverage) are editable in a WPF panel inside DualWriteMapBrowser
Changes persist to TestifyConfigurationStore and reload correctly on next launch
Panel is reachable from the existing Testify toolbar without opening the JSON file

tasks.title: Testify automatic rollback on failure
acceptance: If PATCH or CE-verification fails after a successful POST, the created record is deleted automatically
lastEntityInstanceUrl is cleared from TestifyConfigurationStore after rollback
Cleanup phase returns success (no error) when a cached URL references a record already deleted externally

tasks.title: Testify enum coverage gap reporting
acceptance: Prepare phase output lists each unmapped enum member by field name and enum value
Result grid distinguishes 'Blocked: incomplete coverage' from 'Blocked: missing entity'
TestifyResultRow carries per-field coverage gap detail accessible to the UI

tasks.title: Testify integration test coverage
acceptance: Idempotent rerun with a stale cached entity URL is covered and passes
Automatic rollback on mid-run failure is covered by at least one test
CE poll timeout expiry scenario is covered
All new tests pass under dotnet test with no parallelism failures

tasks.title: Auth silent-failure recovery and interactive fallback
acceptance: Silent token acquisition failure (invalid_grant, expired refresh) triggers an interactive re-auth prompt in the host UI
Plugin operations receive a clear re-authentication message rather than an unhandled HTTP 401
Per-environment TenantId is used for authority resolution, validated at profile save time

tasks.title: Installer GUID lock, code signing, and runtime bundle
tasks.notes: Requires a code-signing certificate; signtool must be available on the build machine. GUID values must be generated once and committed — do not regenerate on each build.
acceptance: ProductCode, UpgradeCode, and Bundle GUID are hardcoded (non-generated) in WiX sources
install/build.ps1 calls signtool to sign MSI and Burn bundle outputs
.NET Desktop Runtime 8.0 installer is chained correctly in the Burn bundle and installs silently on a machine without the runtime
